description.value: Westhill Pool is a seasonal outdoor public swimming pool in Westhill Park, operated by the City of Port Moody. It offers public swims, swim lessons, and Aquafit classes during the summer months. For touring cyclists passing through Port Moody on a hot day, the pool could provide a refreshing break in a pleasant park setting.
